content_html:
If you are planning a trip to Cusco and Machu Picchu, choosing the right time is key to enjoying the best experience. Cusco has two main stations: dry season (May to October) and the rainy season (November to April), each with its advantages and disadvantages. Here we tell you which is the best time according to your interests.

Dry Season (May – October): Best for Trekking and Clear Views

Advantages:

  • Sunny days and clear skies, perfect for spectacular photographs.
  • Better condition of the roads for trekking, such as the Inca Trail and the colorful mountain.
  • Less chance of interruptions due to rain.

Disadvantages:

  • High tourist season, so Machu Picchu and other attractions may be more crowded.
  • Higher prices on accommodation and tours.

Rainy Season (November – April): Green Landscapes and Fewer Tourists

Advantages:

  • Cusco and the Sacred Valley look greener and have impressive natural beauty.
  • Fewer tourists, which means a quieter experience and more affordable prices.
  • Machu Picchu looks spectacular with the morning mist, giving it a mystical air.

Disadvantages:

  • Frequent rains that can affect tours and walks.
  • The Inca Trail closes in February for maintenance.
  • Possible flight or train delays due to weather.

The Best Time According to Your Type of Trip

  • If you want to go trekking: Travel between May and September to avoid rain and enjoy trails in good condition.
  • If you prefer fewer tourists: March, April, October and November These are transition months with fewer crowds.
  • If you are looking for green landscapes: From December to March, the vegetation is at its maximum splendor.
  • If you have a tight budget: In the rainy season, hotel and tour prices are usually lower.

Conclusion

The best time to travel to Cusco and Machu Picchu depends on your priorities. If you prefer good weather and problem-free trekking, choose the dry season. If you are looking for vibrant landscapes and fewer tourists, the rainy season can be ideal. Plan ahead and choose the date that best suits your dream trip.
